description: Use when assessing a technology vendor open-source presence, evaluating developer community strength, or researching a company GitHub footprint before a technical due diligence. Returns organization profile and top repository stats — stars, forks, contributors, and language breakdown. Example: HashiCorp GitHub — 18 public repos, Terraform at 38,000 stars, 147,000 forks, 2,800 contributors — strong community signal supporting enterprise adoption thesis. Source: GitHub public API. $0.02 USDC per call.
